Title: 3 Cushion Billiards
WarmUpHint: Press Space or T (or 3 / Page Down) to pause/resume, R (or 6 / Right Arrow) to reset, Enter to restart, C or Esc (or 9 / Page Up) to return to the board.
ControlsHint: Press C (or 9 / Page Up) to hide, T (or 3 / Page Down) to start/stop the shot clock, R (or 6 / Right Arrow) to reset it. Press 1/2 to switch the active player, +/- to adjust the current points, Enter to commit them. Press W (or 5) to start the warm-up timer, P (or 0 / Insert) to open the player picker, Backspace to close it.
